'''Caulus Tertius''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. No life existed on the planet, although there was evidence to suggest it once supported life. An [[Ophidian grotesques|ophidian grotesque]] sculpture had been discovered at some point in galactic history, which had been much older than the one found on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This sculpture, alongside its Coruscanti counterpart, were later mentioned by Dr. [[Insmot Bowen]] in a debriefing in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] on Coruscant, where he mentioned that it might have been one of the remaining hints to the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]]. Years later, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] remembered several "ophidian grotesque" sculptures, which he remarked were similar to those found on [[Abeloth's planet]].
